N: <int> Number of item families available for selection.
knapsack_capacity: <int> Maximum total weight the knapsack can hold, including both item weights and family setup capacity consumptions.

families.n_i: <int> Number of items belonging to this family.
families.setup_cost: <int> Fixed cost subtracted from profit when this family is activated.
families.setup_capacity: <int> Knapsack capacity consumed when this family is activated.

items.item_id: <int> Unique identifier for this item within its family.
items.weight: <int> Knapsack capacity consumed when this item is placed in the knapsack.
items.profit: <int> Profit earned when this item is placed in the knapsack.
